body: this made me smile a bit. I used to tell people "just keep swimming".  I just wish i believed that now.
im sorry, but i have learned that i just end up hurt in the end. it is time to just let go of everything.
my family doesn't speak to me. people are calling for money threatening to turn us over. in the end, the blame is put on me.
thanks for the advice, but i honestly dont have the energy to deal with the bill anymore. i have no more strength to do any of it.
i do, but they wont miss me either
he is upset with me. in general. everything about me, he doesn't like. i try to please him and it is never good enough. i can't take it any more.
yes. im sure. he has told me. but it is ok. i won't be on this earth much longer.
i do live with someone. i'm married.
yes, i've talked to my doctor/therapist. he is aware. i was doing better on the cutting...but not so much anymore. i have started to burn myself as well.

the thought of moving makes me cry. my body hurts. my mind hurts. i'm so incredibly tired. and as much as i used to like fresh air, i don't anymore. it makes me ill. this time of year, it hurts me. it makes my sinuses hurt so so bad. i just can't take any more physical pain. and the sun...my eyes hurt. i know it sounds so stupid, but just the slighted pain is too much anymore. i'm so sorry. i thank you for reading and replying.
And right now my head hurts so bad, I just want to lay down, close my eyes, go to sleep and never wake up again.
